propositions: Summary results omit the resolved alias field and echo only the caller-supplied ticket_id, causing agents to preferentially select collision-prone four-character prefixes over human-friendly aliases.
Schema and contract definitions for CLI, library, and MCP summary outputs institutionalize the alias-free shape, with no adjacent agent guidance affirming alias selection for tracker commands.

Pinned behavioral evaluations demonstrated that adding the resolved alias to local summaries independently caused agent selection to shift from 25/25 four-character prefixes to 25/25 aliases, while canonical UUID trailers remained stable.

The repair adds the exact resolved alias as an additive summary field, updates schema and documentation across library/CLI/MCP surfaces, and adds affirmative AGENTS guidance to prefer aliases in tracker commands while reserving canonical UUIDs for identity-sensitive artifacts.
